skills.name: Towering (巍峨)
skills.line: The world changes easily, but stone remains unyielding.
skills.description: SP Fukengaku attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 300% of his DEF.

skills.name: Blazing Cliff (炎崖)
skills.line: Ice melts, snow thaws, and flames strike the skies.
skills.description: Exclusive effect. SP Fukengaku creates a Volcanic realm, sustained for 3 turns. All targets that take an action in the realm are inflicted with 1 Scorching Fire stack. When allies use special skills in the realm, their damage dealt is increased by 15%. ;Scorching Fire (炙烤) : :'''Common, Mark''': Max of 5 stacks. When attacked by a Fire Shikigami, the damage received is increased by 16% and 1 stack is removed, then additional damage equal to 300% of SP Fukengaku's DEF is inflicted.

upgrades.text: Boost to damage dealt increases to 25%.
When ally Fire Shikigami use special skills in the realm, their onibi cost is decreased by 1.
Inflicts all enemies with 3 Scorching Fire stacks upon usage.
'''Upper Hand''': Automatically uses this skill at the start of battle.

skills.name: Way Home (归山之路)
skills.description: When an ally Fire Shikigami uses a special skill in the Volcanic realm, SP Fukengaku gains 1 Burning Wick stack. ;Upon Usage :SP Fukengaku gains 2 Burning Wick stacks and restores the HP of all allies by 200% of his initial DEF. ;Burning Wick (熔芯) : :'''Common, Mark''': Max of 8 stacks. Upon gaining a stack, restores the HP of the non-summoned ally with the lowest HP by 200% of SP Fukengaku's initial DEF. At max stacks, removes all stacks and immediately uses Eruption.

upgrades.text: When healing, increases allies' DEF by 25% of SP Fukengaku's initial DEF, lasts for 2 turns.
When healing, increases allies' ATK by 160% of SP Fukengaku's initial DEF (cannot exceed 25% of the ally's initial ATK), lasts for 2 turns.

skills.name: Blazing Mountainfall (崩山炙落)
skills.line: The road is long, but the green mountains remain in sight.
skills.description:
SP Fukengaku attacks all enemies 3 times, dealing damage equal to 600% of his DEF with each attack (a single hit from this skill cannot exceed more than 20x of his initial ATK), then inflicts 5 Scorching Fire stacks. After using this skill for the first time, permanently increases all allies' damage dealt by 30%.
